title: [W]Date of last event - Claim details
h1: [W]What is the date of the most recent event you are complaining about?
hint:
[W]Tell us the date of the latest event related to your claim.

For example, the date you were dismissed, the last act of discrimination, or the most recent incident related to your claim.

dateOfLastEvent.required: [W]Enter the date of the most recent event complained about
dateOfLastEvent.invalidDateInFuture: [W]Date of the most recent event must be in the past
dateOfLastEvent.dayRequired: [W]Date of the most recent event must include a day
dateOfLastEvent.monthRequired: [W]Date of the most recent event must include a month
dateOfLastEvent.yearRequired: [W]Date of the most recent event must include a year
dateOfLastEvent.invalidDate: [W]Date of the most recent event must be a real date
dateOfLastEvent.invalidDateTooFarInPast: [W]Date must not be more than 100 years in the past
